items.name: English Cucumber
items.description: English (or hothouse) cucumbers are cylindrical green-skinned vegetable with a crisp white flesh and edible seeds. English cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can be peeled or eaten with the skin on. Add sliced cucumber to your next vegetable platter or toss with mint and lemon juice for a refreshing salad.

items.name: Bi-Colour Corn, Corn on the Cob
items.description: Bi-colour corn has plump yellow and white kernels in tightly-spaced rows. Corn is covered with a thin layer of golden silk that should be removed prior to cooking. Cook corn and cut the kernels off the cob for salsa, salad, or chili, or boil and serve with butter for classic corn on the cob.

items.name: Green Onion
items.description: Green onions have a firm white base with a small rounded bulb and crisp bright green tops. Scallions are similar but have a straighter white base and slightly milder flavour. Chop fresh green onions for salads or pair with mushrooms for a tart or omelette.

items.name: Yellow Onions, 3 lb Bag
items.description: Product descriptionProduct Number: 20811994001_EA

items.name: Roma Tomatoes
items.description: Roma (or plum) tomatoes are egg-shaped and narrow with a thick red skin and meaty texture. Because they have few seeds and a sweet flavour, Roma tomatoes are a popular choice for making tomato paste and sauce. They can also be used raw in salads or roasted for lasagna and pasta.

items.name: Broccoli Crown
items.description: Broccoli crowns are a versatile and delicious addition to any meal. With their vibrant green colour and unique texture, they can add a refreshing crunch to salads, stir-fries, or roasted vegetable medleys. Broccoli crowns are known for their mild, earthy flavour that pairs well with a variety of seasonings and sauces. Whether you're a seasoned chef or a beginner in the kitchen, incorporating broccoli crowns into your dishes can bring a delightful burst of freshness and contribute to a visually appealing presentation.

items.name: Lettuce Iceberg
items.description: Iceberg (or crisphead) lettuce is a round, tightly-packed head of pale green leaves. It has a crisp texture and a mild flavour and is mainly used fresh. Shred iceberg lettuce for salads and slaws, or cut into wedges and drizzle with blue cheese dressing.

items.name: Sweet Green Peppers
items.description: Green bell peppers have a bright green skin and mild, sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Green bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry, or remove the tops and seeds to make stuffed bell peppers.

items.name: Romaine Heart, 3 Pack
items.description: Romaine hearts are the yellowish leaves in the centre of romaine lettuce. Romaine hearts are smaller and sweeter than romaine bunches and can be enjoyed fresh or cooked. Use romaine hearts to make a classic Caesar salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

items.name: Celery Stalks
items.description: Celery has a cluster of pale green leaved ribs surrounding a heart (inner ribs). Trimmed celery leaves can be used as a garnish or added to a mixed greens salad. Enjoy celery on its own or with dip as a snack, or chop for soups, stews, or a sandwich.

items.name: Red Peppers
items.description: Red bell peppers start with green skin but are left to ripen longer, giving them their bright red skin and sweet, fruity flavour. Enjoy them raw with dips or hummus, or roast red peppers to make dips and soups or as a topping for burgers and bruschetta.

items.name: Mini Cucumbers
items.description: Mini cucumbers are small versions of the English variety with a bit more crunch. Mini cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can eaten with the skin on. Take them with you as a snack on the go or add diced mini cucumbers to your next vegetable platter or salad.

items.name: Tomato Beefsteak Red
items.description: Greenhouse tomatoes are firm and plump with a red skin when ripe. They are perfect sliced and used as a topping on burgers and sandwiches like the classic BLT. Or scoop out the pulp and seeds to make baked stuffed tomatoes.

items.name: Red Onion
items.description: Red (or Italian) onions have a reddish-purple papery skin and a mild sweet flavour. Use red onions to add colour and flavour to just about any dish. Slices of raw red onion work well in salads and as a topping for burgers, or roast and serve with sausage or flank steak.

items.name: Carrots, 3 lb Bag
items.description: Carrots are long and slender and come in a variety of colours in addition to orange. This popular vegetable is available all year and can be eaten raw or cooked in many ways. Try roasting whole carrots, chopping them for soups, stews, and casseroles, or indulge in carrot cake with cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Zucchini
items.description: Zucchini are summer squash with dark to light green skin, white flesh, and tiny edible seeds. They have a delicate flavour and can be eaten raw or cooked in a variety of ways.

items.name: Cauliflower
items.description: Cauliflower is a cruciferous vegetable that comes in a tight cluster of florets surrounded by crisp green leaves. It is normally white but also comes in green, purple, and orange. Add raw cauliflower florets to your next vegetable platter or roast and serve as a simple side dish with meat or fish.

items.name: Ginger
items.description: Ginger (or gingerroot) has a tough tan skin and a fresh spicy fragrance. Ginger can be grated, slivered, or ground and its peppery flavour is used in a variety of dishes. Dried ground ginger has a very different taste and is not a suitable replacement for fresh. Peel gingerroot and add fresh to dressings and marinades, or cook in a stir-fry or soup.

items.name: Grape Tomatoes
items.description: Plump, red Grape Tomatoes work well in a variety of dishes. These juicy grape tomatoes are great on their own as a snack or sliced in your favourite salad. Wash well before use.

items.name: Sweet Baby Peppers (4-Pack)
items.description: Bell peppers have green, orange, red, or yellow skin and a sweet flavour. They are crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus and to add some colour to your stir-fries.

items.name: Sweet Potato
items.description: Sweet potatoes have a thick dark orange skin and sweet orange flesh. Yams are similar in size and shape but are not related to the sweet potato at all. Use sweet potatoes instead of regular potatoes for fries and chips or make a classic sweet potato pie.

items.name: Sweet Onion
items.description: Sweet onions include many varieties, the most common of which is the Vidalia onion. Sweet onions have a golden yellow papery skin and white sweet flesh. They are especially good raw in salads and salsas but sweet onions can also be sliced and braised with beef or fried for onion rings.

items.name: Whole White Mushrooms
items.description: Add the mild and delicate flavour of Whole White Mushrooms to a variety of dishes. These versatile mushrooms are great for adding to texture to entrées, including pastas and stir-fries.

items.name: Garlic Bulbs, 3-count
items.description: Don't forget to add Garlic Bulbs to your weekly shopping list. The pack includes 3 bulbs, so you'll always be prepared when you make soups, stews, pizza, or your favourite stir fry.

items.name: Cabbage, Green
items.description: Cabbages are cruciferous vegetables that range in size, shape, and colour. Green cabbage heads have tightly wrapped leaves with a mild, spicy flavour that can be eaten raw or cooked. Shred cabbage for salad or slaw, or cut into wedges and roast with olive oil and lemon.

items.name: Naturally Imperfect Mixed Sweet Peppers 2.5lb Bag
items.description: Peppers are a part of the nightshade family and vary in taste form sweet to super-hot. Versatile and healthy, enjoy peppers raw or cooked in a variety of fashions.

items.name: Red Onions, 3 lb Bag
items.description: Red (or Italian) onions have a reddish-purple papery skin and a mild sweet flavour. Use red onions to add colour and flavour to just about any dish. Slices of raw red onion work well in salads and as a topping for burgers, or roast and serve with sausage or flank steak.

items.name: Colossal Fresh Garlic
items.description: Garlic has a plump bulb (or head) of individual cloves each covered with a thin skin that can be peeled. Heads of garlic can be roasted whole and the individual cloves can be crushed, chopped, pressed, puréed, or sliced. Try eating fresh parsley after a meal containing garlic to help control odour.

items.name: Broccoli
items.description: Broccoli is a cruciferous vegetable that comes in a tight cluster of florets on top of firm, edible stalks. It is deep green in colour, sometimes with a tinge of purple. Add raw broccoli florets to your next vegetable platter or pair with cheddar cheese for a quiche.

items.name: Vine Tomato (Single Tomato)
items.description: This vine tomato is a great addition to your cooking essentials. Enhance your salads with fresh slices or create a rich, homemade tomato sauce for your pasta dishes.

items.name: Radishes
items.description: Radishes have a wide range of shapes and colours, from round with red or pink skin to carrot-shaped with white skin. They are crisp with a mild or peppery taste, depending on the variety. Slice raw radishes for salads and sandwiches, or roast whole with butter as a simple side dish.

items.name: Green Beans
items.description: There are approximately 7–9 green beans per 25g. Green (or string/snap) beans are long and slender green pods with small edible seeds inside. They are crisp and snap apart when bent. Green beans are easy to prepare and make an excellent side dish. Simply steam or boil the beans until tender-crisp and then toss with light vinaigrette.

items.name: Field Cucumbers
items.description: Field (or garden) cucumbers are cylindrical green-skinned fruit with a crisp white flesh and edible seeds. Field cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and peeled to remove the wax coating. Dice yours for salads and salsas, or add slices of cucumber and lemon to a pitcher of water.

items.name: Yellow Potato, 10 lb Bag
items.description: Yellow (or Yukon Gold) potatoes are a waxy potato with golden yellow skin and flesh with a creamy texture that works especially well for mashed potatoes. Thinly slice for scalloped potatoes or chop with carrots and celery for a classic beef stew.

items.name: Grape Tomato
items.description: Grape tomatoes are small and oval-shaped with a smooth red or yellow skin. They typically have a thicker skin and sweeter flavour than cherry tomatoes. Add raw grape tomatoes to your salads or vegetable platters, or roast with olive oil and serve with goat cheese and crackers.

items.name: Greenhouse Peppers, Orange
items.description: Orange bell peppers have a bright orange skin and sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Orange bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry and are also perfect for grilling.

items.name: Green Leaf Lettuce
items.description: Green leaf lettuce has loosely bunched leaves that are crisp and full-flavoured. Use green leaf lettuce in your next salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

items.name: White Onion
items.description: White onions have a white papery skin and white sharp-tasting flesh. They can be used raw and hold their crunch well when cooked. Chop for salsas and chutneys, or slice and grill with bell peppers for a quick side dish to serve with steak.

items.name: Mini Carrots
items.description: Baby (or mini) carrots are harvested young and usually very tender and sweet. Because they are already peeled, baby carrots are a quick and easy snack for people of all ages. Enjoy baby carrots on their own, add them to your vegetable platter, or roast them with a little olive oil for an easy side dish.

items.name: Romaine Lettuce
items.description: Romaine (or Cos) lettuce has dark green, tightly bunched leaves with crunchy white ribs. It has a slightly bitter flavour and can be used fresh or cooked. Use romaine lettuce to make a classic Caesar salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

items.name: Whole White Mushrooms
items.description: Add the mild and delicate flavour of Whole White Mushrooms to your favourite dishes. These versatile mushrooms are great in entrées or cooked in garlic butter as a savoury side.

items.name: Cucumbers 11 count
items.description: Product descriptionProduct Number: 21070679001_EA

items.name: Jalapeno Peppers
items.description: Jalapeno peppers are slightly rounded chilies with smooth green skin that turns red when ripe. Jalapenos are popular because of their flavour and because they are easy to seed. Add jalapeno peppers to sauces and salsas. Scoville scale rating of 2,500 – 8,000.

items.name: Wax Beans
items.description: There are approximately 2–3 wax beans per 25g. Wax beans are a variety of green bean. They are long and slender pale yellow pods with small edible seeds inside. Wax beans can be used in the same way as green beans. Steam or boil the beans until tender-crisp and then toss with light vinaigrette for a simple side dish.

items.name: Baking Russet Potato
items.description: Baking (or russet) potatoes have a rough brown skin and a tender white flesh with a mild flavour. They are a popular variety of potato and a good choice for baking, mashing, and frying. Peel and boil russets for mashed potatoes, or bake whole and top with sour cream for a side dish for your steak or pork chops.

items.name: Purple Eggplants
items.description: Purple eggplants have glossy, deep purple skin and a meaty texture. Eggplant should only be cut right before use since the flesh discolours quickly. Roast to make eggplant caviar or baba ghanoush, or dice for a classic ratatouille.

items.name: Greenhouse Peppers, Yellow
items.description: Yellow bell peppers have a bright yellow skin and mild, sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Yellow bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry, or remove the tops and seeds to make stuffed bell peppers.

items.name: Red Beets
items.description: Red beets have a smooth, deep red skin and are bright red inside. Use a vegetable peeler to remove the skin of raw beets, or roast them whole in tinfoil and rub the skin off with paper towel. Roast red beets with carrots and potatoes or add slices to salad with goat cheese.

items.name: Naturally Imperfect Mini Cucumbers
items.description: With a satisfying crunch and small size, Mini Cucumbers are easy to prepare and feature a refreshing taste. Enjoy them as a snack on the go or diced into a salad or on a vegetable platter.

items.name: Whole Cremini Mushrooms
items.description: Whole Cremini Mushrooms are destined to be an everyday staple in your kitchen. Nutty yet mild, these mushrooms work in your favourite dinner dishes, from pasta to stir-fry recipes.

items.name: Organics Whole Cremini Mushrooms

items.name: Yellow Onion
items.description: Yellow onions have a light golden skin and a white flesh. These all-purpose onions have a strong flavour and odour and are a very popular choice for cooking. Chop and add to soups, stews, and almost any recipe that calls for onion.

items.name: Sweet Corn, 5-Pack
items.description: Be prepared for weeknight dinners or for that backyard barbecue with Sweet Corn. Boil or grill this sweet corn for a delicious taste. Serve it with butter, salt and pepper, and any other of your favourite seasonings.

items.name: Chayote Squash
items.description: Chayote squash has tough pale green skin, white flesh, and a shape that resembles a pear. They have a mild, bland flavour that absorbs other flavours well and can be cooked in the same ways as zucchini. Add raw chayote squash to salads and slaws, or sauté with garlic and butter for a simple side dish.

items.name: Organic Carrots, 2 lb Bag
items.description: Slice or dice the crunchy goodness of our organic carrots, they're an excellent source of vitamin A. No. 1 Grade.

items.name: Naturally Imperfect White Mushrooms
items.description: White (or button) mushrooms have a white to pale tan colour with a smooth, rounded cap. They have a mild, earthy flavour and can be used raw or cooked. Add white mushrooms to your next vegetable platter or thread on skewers for kebabs on the grill.

items.name: Brussels Sprouts
items.description: Brussels sprouts are cruciferous vegetables that look like tiny cabbage heads. While they range in size, a general rule is that smaller Brussels sprouts tend to be more tender. Approximately 4 brussels sprouts per 100G.

items.name: Ruby Little Gems Potatoes
items.description: Product descriptionProduct Number: 21247299001_EA

items.name: French Beans
items.description: Beans (or Legumes) are the edible seeds of pods that split in half when ripe. High in protein and fiber, beans are great in salads or paired with pasta or greens.

items.name: Carrots, Bunched
items.description: Carrots are long and slender and come in a variety of colours in addition to orange. This popular vegetable is available all year and can be eaten raw or cooked in many ways. Try roasting whole carrots, chopping them for soups, stews, and casseroles, or indulge in carrot cake with cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Ruby & Golden Little Gems Potatoes
items.description: Ruby and Golden Little Gems Potatoes are the perfect, colourful complement to any meal. Pre-washed, they're easy to prepare, and best when grilled, boiled, or roasted.

items.name: Radish
items.description: Radishes have a wide range of shapes and colours, from round with red or pink skin to carrot-shaped with white skin. items.name: Leeks
items.description: Leeks have a thick white stalk and bulb topped by tightly wrapped dark green leaves. They look like large scallions and have a mild onion flavour. Leeks are typically cooked and added to soups and sauces. Try yours sliced and added to quiche along with Gruyere.

items.name: Butternut Squash
items.description: Butternut squash is a pear-shaped winter squash with smooth tan skin and sweet orange flesh. It has a rich, nutty flavour and can generally be used in recipes that call for sweet potatoes. Try butternut squash roasted over a kale salad with goat cheese, or cook and blend for soup.

items.name: Cucumber Dill Basket
items.description: Cucumbers are cylindrical green-skinned fruit with a crisp white flesh and edible seeds. English cucumbers are typically enjoyed raw and can be peeled or eaten with the skin on. items.description: Sweet and crisp, these mini peppers offer a satisfying crunch with every bite. items.name: Celery Hearts
items.description: Celery hearts are the pale green, tender inner ribs of celery. Enjoy celery hearts on their own or with dip as a snack, or chop for soups, stews, or a flavourful tuna salad sandwich.

items.description: A world of peppers, from medium to scorching.Stuffed, candied, pickled or roasted, jalapeños are one of the most versatile peppers around. items.description: White potatoes are a waxy potato with a white, freckled-brown skin and a white flesh that holds its shape well when cooked. They have a rich flavour that works well for potato salad, or quarter and roast with olive oil and garlic.

items.name: Red Cabbage
items.description: Cabbages are cruciferous vegetables that range in size, shape, and colour. Red cabbage heads have tightly wrapped leaves with a peppery flavour that can be eaten raw or cooked. Shred cabbage for salad or slaw, or slice and braise with bacon.

items.name: Snap Peas
items.description: Snap peas are a delightful addition to any meal, offering a satisfying crunch and a subtly sweet flavour. These vibrant green pods are a great choice for those looking to add a touch of freshness to their dishes. With their tender texture and mild taste, snap peas can be enjoyed in a variety of ways, whether lightly sautéed, stir-fried, or simply eaten raw. Give snap peas a try and discover a new level of enjoyment in your culinary adventures.

items.name: Axiany Cherry Tomatoes
items.description: Axiany Cherry Tomatoes are crisp, juicy, and bursting with naturally sweet flavour. Mix them into pasta and grain bowls, or roast them to bring out their rich, savoury sweetness. A source of vitamin C, they're a fresh, vibrant staple for everyday meals.

items.name: Cassava
items.description: Cassava (or yuca) is a starchy root vegetable with a tough brown skin and crisp, white flesh. It has a similar flavour to a potato and can be cooked in many ways. Peel and slice for fried cassava or shred and bake in breads and cakes.

items.name: Red Potatoes
items.description: Red potatoes are a waxy potato with a smooth, reddish skin and a white flesh that holds its shape well when cooked. They have a rich flavour that works well for potato salad, or quarter and roast with olive oil and rosemary.

items.name: Asparagus
items.description: Asparagus stalks range in colour from green to purple, with dark green or purplish tips. Thickness is not a reliable indicator of tenderness, and asparagus is best enjoyed the day of purchase. Try it fresh with dip, roasted with parmesan, or sautéed with bacon.

items.name: Yellow Yams
items.description: Yams are similar in size and shape to sweet potatoes but are not related at all. Yams have rough brown skin and their flesh can be white, yellow, purple, or pink. They have a somewhat bland flavour and can be used as a substitute for potatoes and sweet potatoes in many recipes.

items.name: Shallots
items.description: The dry shallot has been enjoyed throughout the world for centuries. It enhances the flavor of the food it is served with. Widely used in fine cuisine as much as in everyday dishes, the shallot will add refinement to a multitude of meals.

items.name: Carrot Chips

items.name: Collard Greens

items.name: Celery Root

items.description: Cubanelle peppers are a variety of sweet pepper with a long, tapered shape. They range in colour from yellowish-green to red when ripe. Cubanelles are mainly used cooked. Try yours in sauces, sautés, and stir-fries.

items.name: Dandelion Greens
items.description: Dandelion greens are bright green leaves with a slightly bitter flavour. They can be cooked in the same way as spinach but also taste great when used fresh in salads.

items.name: Eddoes
items.description: Eddoes are root vegetables with rough brown skin and bright white flesh. They resemble potatoes or sweet potatoes and can be prepared in the same ways. Peel and boil eddoes for a simple mashed side dish or add to soups, stews, and curries.

items.description: Portobello Mushroom Caps are meaty with a rich flavour. Try grilling them for a meatless alternative to beef burgers, or fill them with bread crumbs, cheese, and garlic and pop them in the oven for a tasty side dish.

items.name: Pumpkin Cut (Squash)
items.description: Skip the peeling and chopping with these ready-to-cook pumpkin cut. Their earthy sweetness is perfect for creating a velvety soup or roasting until tender for a simple side dish. Add them to stews and curries for a boost of colour and flavour.

items.name: Radicchio Lettuce
items.description: Radicchio is a member of the chicory family with firm red leaves, white ribs, and a slightly bitter flavour that becomes sweeter when cooked. Add fresh radicchio leaves to salads and slaws, or sauté with honey and balsamic vinegar to serve with a roast.

items.name: Rapini
items.description: Rapini (or broccoli rabe) has clustered, green broccoli-like florets on thin green stalks. It has a bitter flavour and is best enjoyed cooked. Try yours sautéed with garlic and olive oil and served alongside roast pork.

items.name: Radishes
items.description: Radishes have a wide range of shapes and colours, from round with red or pink skin to carrot-shaped with white skin. They are crisp with a mild or peppery taste, depending on the variety. Slice raw radishes for salads and sandwiches, or roast whole with butter as a simple side dish.

items.name: Red Beets, Bunched
items.description: Red beets have a smooth, deep red skin and are bright red inside. Use a vegetable peeler to remove the skin of raw beets, or roast them whole in tinfoil and rub the skin off with paper towel. Roast red beets with carrots and potatoes or add slices to salad with goat cheese.

items.name: Red Cabbage
items.description: Cabbages are cruciferous vegetables that range in size, shape, and colour. Red cabbage heads have tightly wrapped leaves with a peppery flavour that can be eaten raw or cooked. Shred cabbage for salad or slaw, or slice and braise with bacon.

items.name: Red Leaf Lettuce
items.description: Red leaf lettuce has loosely bunched leaves that are crisp and mild-flavoured. Use red leaf lettuce in your next salad or as a topping for burgers and sandwiches.

items.name: Red Swiss Chard
items.description: Swiss Chard is related to beets and has crinkly, tender greens and celery-like stalks. Red (or ruby) Swiss Chard has dark green leaves, red stalks, and a stronger flavour than the green or rainbow varieties. Cook chard greens in the same way as spinach and the stalks in the same way as asparagus or celery.

items.name: Red Thai Hot Peppers
items.description: A world of peppers, from medium to scorching.Red Thai hot peppers are the ripe version of green Thai chilis and they definitely bring the heat. They’re often used in red curries, but are equally delicious in stir-fries, noodles and soups. PC® Red Thai Hot Peppers are rated in the light red category, meaning they’re extra hot.Did you know that we have a whole new pepper collection that makes it easy for you to spice things up in the kitchen? Each pepper comes in a pack that is clearly labelled with a colour-coded rating: yellow for medium, orange for hot, light red for extra hot, dark red for fiery and burgundy for scorching. If you can handle the heat of a pepper from the light red category, for example, you know you can try others in that same grouping.

items.name: Savoy Cabbage
items.description: Savoy cabbage has distinctly crinkled leaves and a mild, sweet flavour, offering a more tender bite than its plain counterpart. Its texture is perfect for soaking up butter when sautéed for a simple side dish, while the pliable leaves are ideal for making hearty cabbage rolls. Try shredding it raw into slaws and salads for a delicate crunch.

items.name: Scotch Bonnet Hot Peppers
items.description: A world of peppers, from medium to scorching.A scotch bonnet is a legendary pepper that brings the heat, but wait a moment and you’ll taste a sweet almost fruity flavour. Use it in jerk chicken, curries and your fave shrimp dishes. PC® Scotch Bonnet Hot Peppers are rated in the dark red category, meaning they’re fiery hot.Did you know that we have a whole new pepper collection that makes it easy for you to spice things up in the kitchen? Each pepper comes in a pack that is clearly labelled with a colour-coded rating: yellow for medium, orange for hot, light red for extra hot, dark red for fiery and burgundy for scorching. If you can handle the heat of a pepper from the dark red category, for example, you know you can try others in that same grouping.

items.name: Small White Potatoes
items.description: White potatoes are a waxy potato with a white, freckled-brown skin and a white flesh that holds its shape well when cooked. They have a rich flavour that works well for potato salad, or quarter and roast with olive oil and garlic.

items.name: Snow Peas
items.description: Snow peas are a delightful addition to any meal with their crisp texture and subtly sweet flavour. These slender, green pods are a popular choice for stir-fries, salads, and side dishes. Their tender nature allows them to be easily incorporated into a variety of recipes, adding a refreshing element to your culinary creations.

items.name: Spinach, Bunched
items.description: Spinach has dark green leaves that are either flat and smooth or curly and crinkled. Both have crisp, fragrant leaves and a slightly bitter flavour. Spinach can be very gritty and must be rinsed thoroughly. Use raw in salad, combine with feta for spanakopita, or sauté in olive oil and garlic for a simple side dish.

items.name: Sweet Baby Peppers (4-Pack)
items.description: Bell peppers have green, orange, red, or yellow skin and a sweet flavour. They are crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus and to add some colour to your stir-fries.

items.name: Sweet Corn
items.description: Enjoy a sweet taste and a tender texture with Sweet Corn. Boil or grill this sweet corn for a delicious taste. Serve it with butter, salt and pepper, and any other of your favourite seasonings.

items.name: Sweet Green Peppers
items.description: Green bell peppers have a bright green skin and mild, sweet flavour. Their flesh is crisp and juicy, perfect for enjoying raw with dips or hummus. Green bell peppers will add some colour to your stir-fry, or remove the tops and seeds to make stuffed bell peppers.

items.name: Sweet Marvels Grape Tomatoes on the Vine
items.description: Flavour: Shaped like a grape, consider these the cousin of the cherry tomato. Their low acidity and rich, sugary flavour make every bite a mini celebration. Best for: Snack straight from the vine, toss into salads (Greek or pasta), or thread onto skewers for colourful, bursting bites.A source of vitamin C, Sweet Marvels Grape Tomatoes on the Vine are deliciously juicy with a fresh-picked flavour. Greenhouse grown and left on the vine for maximum freshness, they’re perfect for snacking, tossing into salads, or brightening up grain bowls. Sauté or roast them to bring out their rich, caramelized sweetness or use as a colourful topping for pizzas and appetizers.

items.name: Sweet Nantes Carrots
items.description: These firm and sweet carrots are great for salads, stir-fries, or as a delicious side dish when roasted with herbs and spices. Add a touch of sweetness to your meals with Sweet Nantes Carrots.

items.name: Sweet Onion
items.description: Sweet onions include many varieties, the most common of which is the Vidalia onion. Sweet onions have a golden yellow papery skin and white sweet flesh. They are especially good raw in salads and salsas but sweet onions can also be sliced and braised with beef or fried for onion rings.

Soft and spreadable, it glides over toast, melts into warm vegetables, and works just as well for baking or pan-frying.
